nodes.label: Basket Growth Meets Return Risk
nodes.summary:
Superstore’s clearest growth lever is larger baskets: in the March 2015 surge, average order value rose from $321.95 to $2,217.86 while units per order increased from 7.46 to 12.41, showing customers bought more items and higher-value items at the same time [1]. This is strategically important because the broader business has sustained expansion—annual sales rose from $484.2k in 2015 to $733.2k in 2018 while activity grew from 2.0k to 3.3k orders—so preserving basket quality matters as much as adding volume.

Profitability appears to be improving, with gross margin increasing in 14 of 20 visible weeks, but discount changes moved in the same direction in only about 47% of comparable weeks [7]. The concurrent increase in order value and units supports the view that mix and basket expansion, rather than discounting alone, are contributing to the improvement [6]. Finance should therefore prioritize identifying the products, customer groups, and selling motions behind high-value multi-unit orders before treating broader discount changes as the primary margin lever.

Returns are the immediate operational risk to that growth. Standard Class accounts for the largest revenue concentration, at 59.74, yet First Class has the greatest return concentration, at 10.94 [2]; over the last 12 months, First Class also posted the highest return rate at 7.29%, ahead of Second Class at 6.79%, Standard Class at 5.82%, and Same Day at 5.56% [3]. However, another time comparison puts Same Day highest at roughly 7.2%, demonstrating that the leading problem mode changes by period rather than pointing to a stable single culprit [5][8]. Management should immediately review return reasons and delivery promises by ship mode and time period, with each region’s sole regional manager accountable for execution in Central, East, South, and West [4].

data.sql: WITH cat_profit AS (SELECT category, sub_category, SUM(sales) AS revenue, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM orders GROUP BY 1, 2), cat_returns AS (SELECT o.category, o.sub_category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS eligible_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS return_rate FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT cp.category, cp.sub_category, cp.revenue, cp.profit, cr.return_rate FROM cat_profit AS cp JOIN cat_returns AS cr ON cp.category = cr.category AND cp.sub_category = cr.sub_category ORDER BY cp.revenue DESC

data.sql: WITH seg_profit AS (SELECT segment, SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) AS profit_margin_pct FROM orders GROUP BY 1), seg_returns AS (SELECT o.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS eligible_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS return_rate FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT sp.segment, sp.profit_margin_pct, sr.return_rate, sr.returned_orders, sr.eligible_orders FROM seg_profit AS sp JOIN seg_returns AS sr ON sp.segment = sr.segment ORDER BY sp.profit_margin_pct DESC, sr.return_rate ASC

data.sql: WITH phones_sales_by_ship_mode AS (SELECT o.ship_mode, SUM(o.sales) AS phones_sales FROM orders AS o WHERE o.category = 'Technology' AND o.sub_category = 'Phones' GROUP BY 1), phones_total_sales AS (SELECT SUM(o.sales) AS phones_total_sales FROM orders AS o WHERE o.category = 'Technology' AND o.sub_category = 'Phones'), phones_return_rate_by_ship_mode AS (SELECT o.ship_mode, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS phones_return_rate_pct FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.category = 'Technology' AND o.sub_category = 'Phones' GROUP BY 1) SELECT p0.phones_total_sales, sbsm.ship_mode, sbsm.phones_sales, sbsm.phones_sales / NULLIF(p0.phones_total_sales, 0) * 100.0 AS pct_of_phones_total_sales, rr.phones_return_rate_pct FROM phones_total_sales AS p0 JOIN phones_sales_by_ship_mode AS sbsm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN phones_return_rate_by_ship_mode AS rr ON rr.ship_mode = sbsm.ship_mode WHERE sbsm.ship_mode = 'First Class' OR sbsm.ship_mode IN ('Second Class', 'Standard Class', 'Same Day') ORDER BY CASE sbsm.ship_mode WHEN 'First Class' THEN 1 WHEN 'Second Class' THEN 2 WHEN 'Standard Class' THEN 3 WHEN 'Same Day' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

data.sql: WITH max_dates AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM orders), rate_overall AS (SELECT o.ship_mode, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS return_rate_overall FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.ship_mode IN ('Same Day', 'First Class') GROUP BY o.ship_mode), rate_last_12_months AS (SELECT o.ship_mode, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS return_rate_last_12_months FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id CROSS JOIN max_dates AS md WHERE o.ship_mode IN ('Same Day', 'First Class') AND o.order_date >= md.max_order_date - INTERVAL '365' DAY GROUP BY o.ship_mode) SELECT COALESCE(oo.return_rate_overall, 0) AS same_day_return_rate_overall, COALESCE(fl.return_rate_last_12_months, 0) AS first_class_return_rate_last_12_months, COALESCE(of.return_rate_overall, 0) AS first_class_return_rate_overall, COALESCE(sl.return_rate_last_12_months, 0) AS same_day_return_rate_last_12_months, (COALESCE(oo.return_rate_overall, 0) > COALESCE(of.return_rate_overall, 0)) AS same_day_higher_overall_than_first_class, (COALESCE(fl.return_rate_last_12_months, 0) > COALESCE(sl.return_rate_last_12_months, 0)) AS first_class_higher_in_last_12_months_than_same_day FROM (SELECT * FROM rate_overall WHERE ship_mode = 'Same Day') AS oo CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM rate_last_12_months WHERE ship_mode = 'First Class') AS fl CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM rate_overall WHERE ship_mode = 'First Class') AS of CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM rate_last_12_months WHERE ship_mode = 'Same Day') AS sl

data.sql: WITH home_office_returns AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.ship_mode FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.segment = 'Home Office' AND r.returned = TRUE), first_class_returns AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS first_class_returned_orders FROM home_office_returns WHERE ship_mode = 'First Class'), total_home_office_returns AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_home_office_returned_orders FROM home_office_returns) SELECT ROUND((fc.first_class_returned_orders * 100.0) / NULLIF(th.total_home_office_returned_orders, 0), 4) AS first_class_share_of_returned_orders_pct FROM first_class_returns AS fc CROSS JOIN total_home_office_returns AS th

data.sql: WITH weekly_margin AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', o.order_date) AS week_start, SUM(o.profit) AS total_profit, SUM(o.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(o.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(o.sales), 0) AS gross_profit_margin FROM orders AS o GROUP BY 1), weekly_margin_with_change AS (SELECT wm.week_start, wm.gross_profit_margin, wm.gross_profit_margin - LAG(wm.gross_profit_margin) OVER (ORDER BY wm.week_start) AS gross_profit_margin_change FROM weekly_margin AS wm), positive_margin_weeks AS (SELECT week_start FROM weekly_margin_with_change WHERE gross_profit_margin_change > 0), returned_orders_by_week AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', o.order_date) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.returned AND o.ship_mode = 'Same Day' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders_same_day FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN returns AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_date IS NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT rw.week_start, CAST(rw.returned_orders_same_day AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(rw.returned_orders_total, 0) AS same_day_return_fraction FROM returned_orders_by_week AS rw INNER JOIN positive_margin_weeks AS pmw ON rw.week_start = pmw.week_start ORDER BY rw.week_start

data.sql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week, AVG(sales) AS aov, CAST(SUM(quantity) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS units_per_order, SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) AS gross_profit_margin, AVG(discount) AS discount_rate FROM orders WHERE NOT order_date IS NULL GROUP BY 1), changes AS (SELECT week, aov, units_per_order, gross_profit_margin, discount_rate, aov - LAG(aov) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS aov_change, units_per_order - LAG(units_per_order) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS units_per_order_change, gross_profit_margin - LAG(gross_profit_margin) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS gross_profit_margin_change, discount_rate - LAG(discount_rate) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS discount_rate_change FROM weekly), flagged AS (SELECT week, CASE WHEN aov_change > 0 THEN 1 WHEN aov_change < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS sign_aov_change, CASE WHEN units_per_order_change > 0 THEN 1 WHEN units_per_order_change < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS sign_units_per_order_change, CASE WHEN gross_profit_margin_change > 0 THEN 1 WHEN gross_profit_margin_change < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS sign_gross_profit_margin_change, CASE WHEN discount_rate_change > 0 THEN 1 WHEN discount_rate_change < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS sign_discount_rate_change FROM changes WHERE NOT aov_change IS NULL) SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sign_aov_change = 1 AND sign_units_per_order_change = 1 AND sign_gross_profit_margin_change = 1 AND sign_discount_rate_change <> sign_gross_profit_margin_change) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sign_aov_change = 1 AND sign_units_per_order_change = 1), 0)) AS share_of_weeks FROM flagged
